pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: The patches are defined by irregular polygonal geometries with sub-rounded vertices. Pixel transitions at the boundaries are smooth rather than sharp. Patches on the lower neck and anterior shoulder exhibit a significantly larger spatial area than the more frequent, smaller patches on the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored negative space forms a continuous topological graph with high connectivity. Junction nodes are predominantly trivalent. The pathways maintain a relatively uniform pixel thickness throughout the torso, narrowing slightly as they descend toward the ventral region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal neck presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette. The jagged edge is consistent and dense where visible against the background.
